published.title: Nebuchadnezzar's Dream of the Statue
published.summary: Nebuchadnezzar demands that his wise men tell him both his dream and its interpretation. God reveals it to Daniel: a statue of gold, silver, brass, iron and clay is struck by a stone, which Daniel interprets as God’s kingdom overcoming the kingdoms represented by the statue.
